# Space and Product Studio (SAP × Design)
> Space and Product Studio (SAP × Design) is a premier trans-disciplinary architecture, spatial design, and digital product design studio located in Lado Sarai, New Delhi, India.

## Studio Overview
Space and Product Studio operates at the convergence of architectural geometry, physical environments, and digital interface systems. The studio delivers turnkey architectural solutions, bespoke residential and commercial spaces, industrial product design, and digital experiences across India and internationally.

- **Entity Name**: Space and Product Studio
- **Alternate Brand Name**: SAP × Design / SAP Design
- **Studio Discipline**: Architecture, Spatial Design, Physical Product Design, Digital Product & UI/UX Design, Brand Systems
- **Location**: 149 DDA Flat, Lado Sarai, New Delhi, Delhi 110030, India
- **Coordinates**: 28.5265384 N, 77.1953846 E
- **Website**: https://sapxdesign.com/
- **Full LLM Reference**: https://sapxdesign.com/llms-full.txt

---

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Space Design](https://sapxdesign.com/portfolio/space-design): Architectural space planning, residential and commercial architecture, interior architecture, facade engineering, material research, and brutalist/minimalist spatial executions.
- [Product Design](https://sapxdesign.com/portfolio/product-design): Physical product prototyping, industrial design, ergonomic systems, consumer hardware, and design systems for manufacturing.
- [Brand Design](https://sapxdesign.com/portfolio/brand-design): Comprehensive brand identity, visual systems, architectural typography, signage, and packaging.
- [Immersive & Experience Design](https://sapxdesign.com/portfolio/experience-design): Spatial storytelling, interactive installations, sensory retail environments, and digital-physical convergence.

---

## Flagship Case Studies & Projects

- [Haus am See](https://sapxdesign.com/projects/haus-am-see): Minimalist residential lakeside pavilion combining raw poured-in-place concrete, floor-to-ceiling thermal glazing, and custom architectural joinery.
- [Monolith Audio System](https://sapxdesign.com/projects/monolith-audio-system): Precision-machined aluminum and acoustically dampened industrial product design for audiophile-grade sound environments.
- [Neo-Brutalist Flagship](https://sapxdesign.com/projects/neo-brutalist-flagship): Flagship retail experience integrating monolithic stone display plinths, ambient directional lighting, and bespoke interior architecture.
